candidate_explanation.basis: Pinned XLA allocates executable buffers before acquiring collective cliques and before executing Triton calls. Its BFC allocator enables growth when preallocation is false and retains the default disabled garbage collection. The asymmetric reserved memory and flat CPU time favor investigating allocation/setup first.
candidate_explanation.description: Rank 0 may be blocked in initial buffer allocation or related setup while rank 1 waits at initial collective-clique acquisition. Allocation growth, fragmentation or memory-budget pressure are candidates; the memory snapshot does not distinguish them.
candidate_explanation.limitations: No native thread stack or allocator-failure report established the exact cause. The successful tiny collective does not qualify the full graph. This train-step Triton autotune is not demonstrated to have started.
